card.band: 20 h. Large surface (about 500 fixtures across the three languages) gives dense credit. A frontier agent gets the common cases and not comment placement. A weaker model stops at plain CSS.
card.cheat: Shipping or installing Prettier, or hard-coding fixture outputs. Closed by no node or prettier in the image, a mutated hidden set and a language restriction.
card.grading: Hidden inputs, drawn from the CSS/SCSS/Less fixtures and mutated variants whose expected outputs are precomputed with the pinned Prettier, with several option sets. Exact output match per case; score is the fraction passed over the reference's.
card.reference: Our own implementation of the CSS-family subset, checked against the pinned Prettier outputs. About 3-5k lines.
card.task: /app ships a CLI skeleton and a few sample inputs. The agent implements a formatter for CSS, SCSS and Less (comments, at-rules, maps, math, selectors, options) that reproduces Prettier's output byte for byte, in a language other than JS.

Band.why: No dated public evidence of agents on this task; estimate capped at 3.

Build.why: Reference of 3-5k lines plus oracle and mutation pipeline is roughly 3-5 days.

Fit.why: CPU-only and offline at runtime; Node is needed only for the outside precompute.

Hor.why: 20 h tier is justified by a large multi-syntax surface.

Multi.why: Comments, at-rules, maps, math, selectors and options give many buckets.

Nov.why: Max neighbour 0.174 is slightly over 0.15; not a crowded subject, but close to seeds.

Ref.why: No reference built; the only existing reference is Prettier's JS printer, so a non-JS reference must be written and its completeness is unproven.

Surf.why: Thousands of cases possible via mutation, but base fixture count across the three languages is unverified.

spike_plan.kill_if: Fewer than about 150 usable cases across CSS/SCSS/Less, or nondeterministic outputs.
spike_plan.pass_if: Three-language fixture total is at least 300 and two runs are byte-identical across all option sets.
steps: In a throwaway networked container, clone prettier/prettier and check out tag 3.9.10; confirm the commit (expect 1172b82c, not ca892240).
Count fixtures under tests/format/css, tests/format/scss and tests/format/less; record the total.
Run prettier on all fixtures with default options and two option sets; store output hashes.
Re-run the same commands and confirm byte-identical outputs (determinism).
Build 200 mutated variants (whitespace, comment moves, reordered declarations) and run prettier on them; confirm stable output.
Confirm the smoke_build amber result does not affect this oracle: the upstream jest suite is nondeterministic and is not used for grading.

v1.summary: The repo is real and MIT-licensed, but the pinned commit is wrong: tag 3.9.10 is 1172b82c, not ca892240, and the SCSS/Less fixture counts and the 3-5k line reference are unverified. No kill; the card goes to a spike that checks the fixture total and determinism before any build, with E0 evidence and a Band of 3 at most.
